question: 列出这个系统所有计算 premium 的地方，说明每项怎样算、何时适用、调用派生、logical view 来源和最后影响。
oracle_policy: Hand-author business sites and evidence spans before indexing. Never derive expected site IDs/counts from the same retrieval/ranker/parser being tested.

modules.name: multiple_disconnected_roots
modules.shape: Six independent roots: quote, issue, renewal, endorsement, cancellation, collection. Include premium calculations in every root; no single CALL closure reaches them all.
modules.trap: A one-entry answer must not pass a repository-wide question.

modules.name: business_alias_and_parameter_mapping
modules.shape: Document premium/PRM/due-charge terminology in a neutral approved glossary. CALL USING changes PREMIUM-AMOUNT to IO-VALUE in a generic calculator with no premium token. Include one unrelated IO-VALUE elsewhere.
modules.trap: Name match alone cannot merge identities or miss a call-derived calculation.

modules.name: logical_view_input_lineage
modules.shape: SELECT an LF; DDS maps it to a physical rate record. Rate affects a downstream formula. A second LF with the same spelling under another library remains ambiguous without library binding.
modules.trap: Mapping-only LV is an input dependency, not a formula; source filenames alone do not establish runtime binding.

modules.name: business_calculation_forms
modules.shape: Include COMPUTE, ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE sequences, per-item accumulation, per-payment factor, fee, discount, tax, prorating, refund, rounded output and error-path clearing.
modules.trap: COMPUTE-only retrieval misses business arithmetic; raw MOVE inventory is not business explanation.

modules.name: copy_instances_and_overwrites
modules.shape: Two callers include one procedure COPY with different REPLACING factors; place guards in callers, formula in nested COPY and late override after returning. Include identical physical names in different directories.
modules.trap: Neither deduplication nor compaction may merge incompatible instances or omit later business adjustments.

modules.name: decoys_and_hidden_tail
modules.shape: More than 80 high-ranking premium DISPLAY/comment/heading decoys; a true calculation at a lexically late path and deep physical span. Include counters and report-only moves.
modules.trap: Top-k hits cannot be treated as an exhaustive universe; negative controls must remain excluded.

modules.name: resumable_scale
modules.shape: Parameterize at least 37 calculation sites in a file, more than 16 LV objects, more than 4 source paths per batch and a 12-layer call chain; add known sites across disconnected roots.
modules.trap: A completed current batch is not completed enumeration. Preserve an independent oracle for generated site count and exact locations.

modules.name: declared_boundaries
modules.shape: Variants with dynamic unresolved call, missing COPY, skipped extension/file, unreadable source, partial line, duplicate target name and missing runtime rate rows.
modules.trap: Retain the known detailed business inventory, list exact gaps, and prohibit an exhaustive claim.

modules.name: recovery_and_requirement_change
modules.shape: Force compaction between batches, save/reopen, known HTTP 500 after completed reading, unknown remote outcome, and follow-up in a different locale.
modules.trap: No loss/repetition of completed enumeration, no automatic retry of unknown outcome, and no stale complete answer under new requirements.

real_model_required_judgment: all gold sites appear in the delivered answer or complete export
each site's business role, applicability, derivation and output consequence are correct
known rules are not replaced with a blanket inability to answer
unknown binding/runtime data are distinguished from source absence
execution_boundary: This is an unimplemented neutral fixture design. No repository mutation, no source/model/network access and no success claim. Building a test later does not imply company validation.
